oe_v47_act_varna_three_crown_compact = {
	icon = bless_the_banners
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
			NOT = { country_type = pop }
			NOT = { country_type = building }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 100
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_three_crown_compact }
		}
	}
	cooldown = {
		type = oe_v47_act_varna_three_crown_compact_cd
		years = 6
	}
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:oe_sit_v47_varna_crusade = {
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:oe_sit_v47_varna_crusade = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -100
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_three_crown_compact years = 12 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_crusade_camp value = 1 }
			remove_variable = oe_v47_varna_ottoman_camp
			add_prestige = 6
			if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { tag = TUR } } add_casus_belli = { target = c:TUR type = casus_belli:cb_crusade years = 12 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu1_2_seen } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu1_2_seen value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu1.2 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_varna_momentum } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum value = 15 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum add = 16 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_varna_momentum > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum value = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_varna_momentum < -100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_varna_momentum value = -100 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v47_act_varna_three_crown_compact_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 240 } } add = 12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 140 } } add = -12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { OR = { tag = POL tag = HUN tag = BYZ tag = WAL tag = SER } } } add = 20 }

}

	}

			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_atlantic_exile_fleet years = 15 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_exile_camp value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_new_cordoba_founded value = 1 }
			add_navy_tradition = 8
			location:santiago = { discover_location = scope:actor }
			location:arguin = { discover_location = scope:actor }
			location:paranabuku = { discover_location = scope:actor }
			location:sauipe = { discover_location = scope:actor }
			if = { limit = { OR = { is_ai = no has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed } location:santiago = { has_owner = no } } location:santiago = { change_location_owner = scope:actor } }
			else_if = { limit = { OR = { is_ai = no has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed } location:paranabuku = { has_owner = no } } location:paranabuku = { change_location_owner = scope:actor } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu1_27_seen } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu1_27_seen value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu1.27 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_fortune } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune value = 10 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune add = -22 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_andalus_fortune > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune value = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_andalus_fortune < -100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune value = -100 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v47_act_andalus_atlantic_exile_fleet_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 240 } } add = 12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 140 } } add = -12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { tag = GRA OR = { num_locations <= 8 at_war = yes has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed } } } add = 14 }
